messages:
Asha Kapoor: Dropping a new compact latency-row mock — big p95, tiny throughput sparkline, sampling pill top-right. Trying to keep rows dense for grids. Feedback? :wave:
Tom Becker: Looks good. One thought: the sampling pill should show 'Adaptive' vs 'Fixed 10%' so state is visible without opening popover. Also label the sparkline axis 'RPS'.
Maya Chen: Accessibility: pill needs keyboard focus + aria-expanded. Popover must announce when opened. Also ensure focus trap is NOT used (we're in-panel). Add sr-only definition: 'Sampling controls reduce plotted traces to save cost and improve signal'.
Omar Ruiz: UX: on hover show exact p95 and throughput tooltip. On very small widths hide sparkline and show a tiny chevron to expand row details. Mobile: single-line p95 only.
Asha Kapoor: Agreed. Copy tweak: badge text => 'Sampling: Adaptive' (capitalize). Popover title 'Sampling settings'. Help link 'What is sampling?' to docs.
Tom Becker: Can we surface an "est. cost" micro-line in the popover? If so, hide it behind a 'Show est. cost' toggle to avoid confusion.
Maya Chen: If showing cost, prefix with 'Estimated' and add tiny helper: 'Estimated rendering cost for sampled traces only; not a billing statement.' Announce changes to sample rate with polite live region.
Omar Ruiz: Engineering note: when collapsing throughput, maintain tooltip data so users can still see RPS on expand.
DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-check failed for pill text at current token color; recommend using token text-strong or +font-weight. Tag: design-accessibility. :robot_face:
Asha Kapoor: Cool — I'll update the figma with the pill state label, aria snippet, and mobile collapse behavior. Will post link when ready. :raised_hands:
